P.name: Warpath
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Hecarim''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|12 to 24 for 7|1;3 to 18|formula=12%+2% every 3 levels starting from level 3 and capped at level 18}} of his {{sti|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.

Q.name: Rampage
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Hecarim''' cleaves his glaive around himself, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies, reduced to 60% against {{tip|minions}}.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|60 to 180}} {{as|(+ 90% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Minion damage|{{ap|60*0.6 to 180*0.6}} {{as|(+ {{ap|90*0.6}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description2: If this damages an enemy, '''Hecarim''' gains a {{tip|stack}} of ''Rampage'' for 8 seconds,  refreshing on subsequent damage and stacking up to 3 times. Each stack increases ''Rampage's'' damage by 3% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} and reduces its {{sti|cd|'''base''' cooldown}} by {{fd|0.75}} seconds, up to a 9% {{as|(+ 9% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} damage increase and a {{fd|2.25}}-second reduction of the '''base''' cooldown at maximum stacks. Stacks expire one by one every 1 second when the duration ends.
Q.cooldown: {{pp|4-0.75*(x-1)|0 to 3 by 1|type=''Rampage'' stacks|formula=4 - 0.75 * [''Rampage'' stacks], capped at 3 stacks.|label=cooldown}}

W.name: Spirit of Dread
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Hecarim''' surrounds himself with the Spirit of Dread for 4 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every second to nearby enemies.
W.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|20 to 60}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|20*4 to 60*4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*4}}% AP)}}}}
W.description2: While active, '''Hecarim''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} and is {{tip|heal|healed}} for 25% of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt to enemies within the area from all sources, halved to {{ap|25/2}}% for damage dealt by allies. The healing is capped against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.

E.name: Devastating Charge
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Hecarim''' becomes {{tip|ghosted}} and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pp|type=time active|key=%|25 to 65 for 13|0 to 3|formula=3.3% '''total bonus''' movement speed every 0.25 seconds. ''This is capped at 3 seconds.''}} '''bonus total''' movement speed|ms}}}} for 4 seconds.
E.description2: During this time, '''Hecarim's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is replaced by a ''Devastating Charge'', empowering it to gain {{pp|type=distance traveled|50 to 250 for 9|0 to 1200}} {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} and cause him to {{tip|dash}} in the target's direction, {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 1 second. If the target remains nearby during the dash, the {{tip|ghosting}} and {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} ends prematurely and '''Hecarim''' {{tip|airborne|knocks them back}} {{pp|type=distance traveled|150 to 350 for 9|0 to 1200}} units, though not through terrain, {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, and deals them {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}}, increased by {{pp|type=distance traveled|key=%|0 to 100 for 9|0 to 1200}}.
E.description3: ''Devastating Charge'' can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Hecarim|crit_base}}|100|base=100}}|critical damage}} {{as|AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
E.description4: ''Devastating Charge {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Hecarim's''' basic attack timer. '''Hecarim''' can cast any of his {{tip|champion ability|abilities}} during the dash. Devastating Charge's duration is paused during {{ai|Onslaught of Shadows|Hecarim}}.''
E.leveling2: {{st|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|30 to 90}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Maximum Physical Damage|{{ap|30*2 to 90*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}

R.name: Onslaught of Shadows
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Hecarim''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} to the target location and summons 5 spectral riders {{tt|in an arrow formation|see notes}} that charge alongside him in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies in their path and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.
R.description2: Upon arrival, he {{tip|fear|fears}} nearby enemies for {{pp|type=distance traveled|0.75 to 1.5 for 11|0 to 1000}} seconds and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by {{pp|type=distance from '''Hecarim'''|0;0 to 99|0;150 to 300 by 25|formula=Minimum of 0% slow at ≤150 centered range from '''Hecarim''', maximum of 99% at 300 centered range from '''Hecarim''' (linearly interpolated).|key=%}}.
R.description3: ''The wave of spectral riders travels independently of '''Hecarim''' and will always charge at the same distance.''
